commission.prompt:
Editorial architecture photograph of a vast exhibition hall at night: dark charcoal concrete floor and deep shadowed concrete walls, no ceiling fixtures visible in the frame. Four flat sheets of transparent coloured glass hang from fine cables in a staggered row that steps toward the camera <glass_sheets>, each sheet exactly twice the area of the one before: a small sunflower-yellow sheet farthest away, an emerald-green sheet twice its size, a magenta sheet twice that size, and an enormous cobalt-blue sheet nearest the camera, cut off by the right edge of the frame. Hard light from unseen fixtures above shines down through the glass and lays sharp-edged, saturated rectangles of yellow, green, magenta and cobalt light on the floor <light_shapes>, overlapping into mixed colours where they meet; everything else falls into near-black. Clean air: no haze, no fog, no visible light beams, no glow, no neon tubes, no lens flare, no visible lamps or spotlights. The left third of the frame is dark and calm, with only faint coloured light on the floor <quiet_zone>. No people, no furniture, no text, no signage, no logos, no screens or devices. Medium format camera, 35 mm equivalent lens at eye level, sharp throughout, fine grain, deep blacks, saturated colour.
